title: A conversion table
description:
Print a table of temperatures with functions that take default arguments.

```

  0   32.0
 10   50.0
 20   68.0
 30   86.0
 40  104.0
```

hints: `range(start, stop + 1, step)` includes `stop`. `f"{c:3} {f:6.1f}"` right-aligns the numbers in columns.
`print_table` should call `celsius_to_fahrenheit`, so the formula lives in one place.
requirements: `print_table(start=0, stop=40, step=10)` prints the rows, `stop` included.
Call it once with the defaults and once as `print_table(-10, 10, 5)`.
